description: Belgian company annual accounts: list every published deposit of a Belgian company at the NBB CBSO (Central Balance Sheet Office, Authentic Data), with deposit references with filing metadata as published. A sole proprietorship or a legal form in doubt in the KBO copy is refused (404, not charged) without calling the NBB; so is an enterprise number the KBO copy does not hold or whose name is under objection (the profile's 404), and an empty KBO copy answers 503 collecte_en_cours. Unique on x402: no other service exposes Belgian filed accounts. No default-risk score is computed for this country yet: the response carries score_defaillance (statut non_evaluable, closed-list reasons that GET /v1/lecture explains); never read it as a low score. Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
